Solution 04

Industrial Material Handling

Screw conveyors, bucket elevators and discharge units for moving product through a plant.

Request a QuoteContact Our Team

01Overview

What this solution covers.

Conveyors and elevators link process stages, and discharge units empty silos and filters. Lengths, heights and drives vary with the plant, so each enquiry starts from the site layout.

Application areas

  • Flour and grain transfer
  • Silo and filter discharge
  • Plant layouts with several floors

02Process information

How the process runs.

  1. 01

    Layout

    Machine positions and product routes are set in a layout diagram.

  2. 02

    Horizontal transfer

    Screw conveyors carry product between machines.

  3. 03

    Vertical transfer

    Dust-isolated bucket elevators lift product between levels.
